canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page backgrounds, card surfaces, product card backgrounds

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

true-black.$description: True Black — Headlines, icons, high-contrast borders, nav text

warm-sand.$description: Warm Sand — Hero section background, secondary surface tone, large editorial panels

olive-char.$description: Olive Char — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

iron-gray.$description: Iron Gray — Secondary text, helper copy, subtle borders

stone.$description: Stone — Muted borders, disabled dividers, footer separators

slate-border.$description: Slate Border — Outlined button border color

oat-milk.$description: Oat Milk — Tertiary surface, subtle nav tint, warm off-white alt background

mist.$description: Mist — Soft shadow tone for elevated elements

self-modern.$description: Display headlines and editorial copy — used sparingly for hero statements and collection titles. The serif italic-leaning forms break the sans-serif monotony and signal 'this is the story'.

geograph.$description: The workhorse UI typeface — body copy, nav labels, buttons, product titles, footers, inputs, badges. 500 for emphasized labels, 700 for product names. Wide letter-spacing (0.025em–0.10em) on uppercase nav and category labels gives the brand its editorial cadence.

hurmegeometricsans3.$description: Rarely used — a fallback or specialized button label variant. Geograph carries the system day-to-day.
